name: Git
description: WebStorm-style Git log for Orca: branches, commits and the files of a multi-commit selection in the sidebar, their diffs in a Diff tab. Fork of emamalet/Orca-git-log-panel.

cover.alt: Git sidebar on the right with six selected commits and their files, and the Diff tab with a unified diff of one of those files on the left

screenshots.alt: Six selected commits across two merges, the files they changed as a tree and the details of each commit in the sidebar; the Diff tab shows one of the files
screenshots.caption: Select commits in the sidebar, see the files of the whole selection and open one in the Diff tab

screenshots.alt: Diff tab with a side-by-side diff of a TypeScript file and syntax highlighting
screenshots.caption: Click a file to see its diff in the Diff tab, side by side or unified

screenshots.alt: Branches section of the sidebar expanded: local and remote branches grouped into folders by prefix
screenshots.caption: Branch tree grouped into folders, with checkout, rename, merge and rebase actions

settings.title: Git executable
settings.description: Path or name of the git binary used by the log.

settings.title: Commits per page
settings.description: How many commits are loaded at once while scrolling.

settings.title: Offer a backup before risky operations
settings.description: Squash, fixup, drop, reword, interactive rebase, rebase onto, reset and deleting an unmerged branch offer to save a backup branch or tag first, in their confirmation.

settings.title: Backup kind
settings.description: What the backup offer creates by default. The last choice made in a confirmation is kept here.
